info.title: Polymarket WebSocket Streams API
info.description:
Polymarket WebSocket streaming API.

## Connection

```
wss://api.struct.to/ws
```

## Authentication

**API key** — pass via header or query param:
```
X-Api-Key: <your-api-key>
```
```
wss://api.struct.to/ws?api-key=<your-api-key>
```

**Public-key JWT** — for `pk_jwt_*` keys. Your users authenticate with a JWT you sign; credits are charged to your org.
```
Authorization: Bearer <end-user-jwt>
```
```
wss://api.struct.to/ws?token=<end-user-jwt>
```

## Joining a room

```json
{"type":"join_room","payload":{"room_id":"polymarket_trades"}}
```

## Subscribing

After joining, send a `room_message` with room-specific filters:
```json
{
"type": "room_message",
"payload": {
"room_id": "polymarket_trades",
"message": {"action":"subscribe","condition_ids":["0xabc…"]}
}
}
```

## Keepalive

Send `{"type":"ping"}` every 30s. Server responds with `{"type":"pong"}`. Connections idle for more than 60 seconds are closed.

## Pricing

Billed **per message** at different rates per room. A **1-credit hold** is charged on connect. Fractional credits accumulate and are **rounded up** on disconnect.

| Room | Credits per message |
|---|---|
| `polymarket_trades` (Trades) | 0.002 |
| `polymarket_order_book` (Order Book) | 0.001 |
| `polymarket_asset_prices` (Asset Prices) | 0.005 |
| `polymarket_asset_window_updates` (Asset Window Updates) | 0.025 |
| `polymarket_market_metrics` (Market Metrics) | 0.025 |
| `polymarket_event_metrics` (Event Metrics) | 0.025 |
| `polymarket_tag_metrics` (Tag Metrics) | 0.025 |
| `polymarket_position_metrics` (Position Metrics) | 0.025 |
| `polymarket_trader_pnl` (Trader PnL) | 0.1 |
| `polymarket_trader_pnl_v3` (Trader PnL v3) | 0.1 |
| `polymarket_trader_positions` (Trader Positions) | 0.005 |
| `polymarket_trader_positions_v3` (Trader Positions v3) | 0.005 |
| `polymarket_trader_position_resolved_v3` (Trader Position Resolved v3) | 0.025 |
| `polymarket_accounts` (Accounts) | 0.005 |
| `polymarket_clob_rewards` (CLOB Rewards) | 0.01 |
| `polymarket_events_stream` (Events Stream) | 0.025 |
| `polymarket_markets_stream` (Markets Stream) | 0.025 |
| `polymarket_oracle_events` (Oracle Events) | 0.025 |

`pong`, `room_joined`, `room_left`, and error messages are free.

polymarket_asset_prices.title: Asset Prices
polymarket_asset_prices.description:
Real-time crypto-asset price feed (BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, DOGE, BNB, HYPE). Delivers both raw `asset_price_tick` events on every price update and `asset_price_window_update` events at candle open/close boundaries.

**Filter (optional):** `asset_symbols` — uppercase symbols to filter by. Empty array subscribes to all symbols.

**Unsubscribe:** Send `action: "unsubscribe_all"`.

polymarket_asset_window_updates.title: Asset Window Updates
polymarket_asset_window_updates.description:
Filtered stream of asset-price candle open/close events. Unlike `polymarket_asset_prices`, this room **requires** at least one filter so clients receive only the symbols and/or timeframes they care about.

**Filters (at least one required):**
- `asset_symbols` — uppercase symbols: `"BTC"`, `"ETH"`, `"SOL"`, `"XRP"`, `"DOGE"`, `"BNB"`, `"HYPE"`
- `timeframes` — candle sizes: `"5m"`, `"15m"`, `"1h"`, `"4h"`, `"1d"` / `"24h"`

**Unsubscribe:** Send `action: "unsubscribe_all"`.

polymarket_market_metrics.title: Market Metrics
polymarket_market_metrics.description:
Real-time volume and transaction-count metrics per market condition, aggregated across multiple timeframes (`1m`, `5m`, `30m`, `1h`, `6h`, `24h`, `7d`, `30d`). One event is pushed per timeframe window on each update.

**Filter (required):** `condition_ids` — 64-char hex condition IDs. Invalid or malformed IDs are returned in `rejected`.

**Unsubscribe:** Send `action: "unsubscribe_all"`.

polymarket_event_metrics.title: Event Metrics
polymarket_event_metrics.description:
Real-time volume and transaction-count metrics aggregated at the event (parent market group) level, across multiple timeframes. One event is pushed per timeframe window on each update.

**Filter (required):** `event_slugs` — event slugs (lowercase).

**Unsubscribe:** Send `action: "unsubscribe_all"`.

polymarket_tag_metrics.title: Tag Metrics
polymarket_tag_metrics.description:
Real-time volume and transaction-count metrics aggregated by tag, across multiple timeframes. One event is pushed per timeframe window on each update.

**Filter (required):** `tags` — tag labels or slugs, matched case-insensitively.

**Unsubscribe:** Send `action: "unsubscribe_all"`.

polymarket_position_metrics.title: Position Metrics
polymarket_position_metrics.description:
Real-time volume, trade-count, and OHLC price/probability metrics per outcome-token position, across multiple timeframes. One event is pushed per timeframe window on each update.

**Filter (required):** `position_ids` — ERC-1155 token IDs (decimal or hex).

**Unsubscribe:** Send `action: "unsubscribe_all"`.

polymarket_trader_pnl.title: Trader PnL
polymarket_trader_pnl.description:
Real-time profit-and-loss updates for tracked traders. PnL is computed at three granularities — `global` (whole portfolio), `market` (per condition), `event` (per event) — and each granularity is maintained over four rolling windows: `1d`, `7d`, `30d`, `lifetime`. The stream emits **one event per (granularity, timeframe) slice** whenever that slice changes; every event carries a `timeframe` field identifying which window it belongs to.

**Filter (required):** `traders` — EVM wallet addresses. Invalid addresses are returned in `rejected`.

**Optional filters:**
• `update_types` — subset of `["global", "market", "event"]`. Omit or leave empty to receive all three update types.
• `timeframes` — subset of `["1d", "7d", "30d", "lifetime"]`. Omit or leave empty to receive all timeframes.

Any unknown value in `update_types` or `timeframes` rejects the entire subscription with an `error` message (values are case-insensitive and trimmed).

**Events pushed:** `trader_global_pnl_update`, `trader_market_pnl_update`, `trader_event_pnl_update`.

**Unsubscribe:** Send `action: "unsubscribe_all"`.

polymarket_trader_pnl_v3.title: Trader PnL v3
polymarket_trader_pnl_v3.description:
Real-time profit-and-loss updates for tracked traders. PnL is computed at four granularities — `global` (whole portfolio), `market` (per condition), `event` (per event), `category` (per market category) — and each granularity is maintained over four rolling windows: `1d`, `7d`, `30d`, `lifetime`. The stream emits **one event per (granularity, timeframe) slice** whenever that slice changes; every event carries a `timeframe` field identifying which window it belongs to.

**Filter (required):** `traders` — EVM wallet addresses. Invalid addresses are returned in `rejected`.

**Optional filters:**
• `update_types` — subset of `["global", "market", "event", "category"]`. Omit or leave empty to receive all four update types.
• `timeframes` — subset of `["1d", "7d", "30d", "lifetime"]`. Omit or leave empty to receive all timeframes.

Any unknown value in `update_types` or `timeframes` rejects the entire subscription with an `error` message (values are case-insensitive and trimmed).

**Events pushed:** `trader_global_pnl_update_v3`, `trader_market_pnl_update_v3`, `trader_event_pnl_update_v3`, `trader_category_pnl_update_v3`.

**Unsubscribe:** Send `action: "unsubscribe_all"`.

polymarket_trader_positions.title: Trader Positions
polymarket_trader_positions.description:
Real-time position updates for tracked traders. Streams full position snapshots whenever a position PnL changes.

**Filter (required):** `traders` — EVM wallet addresses. Invalid addresses are returned in `rejected`.

**Events pushed:** `trader_position_update` — includes PnL fields, shares balance, market slug, outcome, and all enriched data.

**Unsubscribe:** Send `action: "unsubscribe_all"`.

polymarket_trader_positions_v3.title: Trader Positions v3
polymarket_trader_positions_v3.summary: Trader position updates and resolutions stream (v3)
polymarket_trader_positions_v3.description:
Real-time position updates for tracked traders. Emits both long-running lifetime position snapshots (PnL changes) and one-shot resolution signals when a position resolves.

**Filter (required):** `traders` — EVM wallet addresses. Invalid addresses are returned in `rejected`.

**Optional filters:**
• `update_types` — subset of `["lifetime", "resolved"]`. Omit or leave empty to receive both.

**Events pushed:**
• `trader_position_lifetime_update_v3` — full position snapshot, pushed whenever a position's PnL changes.
• `trader_position_resolved_v3` — pushed once when a position resolves.

**Unsubscribe:** Send `action: "unsubscribe_all"`.

polymarket_trader_position_resolved_v3.title: Trader Position Resolved v3
polymarket_trader_position_resolved_v3.description:
Real-time one-shot signals emitted when a tracked trader's position resolves. Use this room when you only need the resolution event; for the full lifetime PnL stream see `polymarket_trader_positions_v3`.

**Filter (required):** `traders` — EVM wallet addresses. Invalid addresses are returned in `rejected`.

**Events pushed:** `trader_position_resolved_v3` — full position snapshot at resolution. Inspect `won` to see whether the outcome paid out.

**Unsubscribe:** Send `action: "unsubscribe_all"`.

polymarket_accounts.title: Accounts
polymarket_accounts.description:
Real-time balance updates for Polymarket wallet accounts.

Always streams ERC-1155 outcome token (shares) balance changes for subscribed wallets as `accounts_update` events. Opt in to additional token streams via boolean flags:
- `include_usdce: true` — also receive `usdce_update` events (USDCe collateral, V1)
- `include_pusd: true` — also receive `pusd_update` events (pUSD collateral, V2 CLOB)
- `include_matic: true` — also receive `matic_update` events (MATIC gas balance)

**Filter (required):** `wallets` — EVM wallet addresses. Invalid addresses are returned in `rejected`.

**Unsubscribe:** Send `action: "unsubscribe_all"`.

polymarket_order_book.title: Order Book
polymarket_order_book.description:
Real-time CLOB orderbook snapshots for Polymarket outcome tokens. Each event contains the full aggregated bid/ask book plus pre-computed derived metrics (best bid/ask, mid price, spread, USD liquidity depth, level counts).

**Filters (at least one required, max 500 combined):**
- `condition_ids` — 64-char hex condition IDs (market); delivers snapshots for all positions in that market
- `position_ids` — hex token/asset IDs (individual outcome tokens)

**Unsubscribe:** Send `action: "unsubscribe_all"`.

polymarket_clob_rewards.title: CLOB Rewards
polymarket_clob_rewards.description:
Real-time stream of Polymarket CLOB reward configuration changes. Emits events when rewards are added to a market, removed, or updated (e.g. rate changes, sponsor count changes, spread/size threshold changes).

**Filters (optional):**
- `condition_ids` — 64-char hex condition IDs to watch for reward changes
- `subscribe_all` — set to `true` to receive ALL reward changes across all markets

If neither is provided, no events are delivered.

**Event types:**
- `added` — new reward configuration appeared on a market
- `removed` — reward configuration removed from a market
- `updated` — reward parameters changed (rate, spread, size, sponsors, etc.)

**Unsubscribe:** Send `action: "unsubscribe_all"`.

polymarket_events_stream.title: Events Stream
polymarket_events_stream.summary: Real-time Polymarket events stream — filter or ids mode, 500ms to 10s cadence
polymarket_events_stream.description:
Low-latency push feed of `PolymarketEvent` rows — same row shape `GET /polymarket/events` returns. The stream sends updates for open events as market activity and event metrics change.

**Seeding:** No initial snapshot is pushed on subscribe. Clients seed local state from `GET /polymarket/events` and then apply deltas from this stream.

**Subscription model:** A client has up to 8 active slots per room (4 cadences × 2 modes). Re-subscribing to the same `(interval_ms, mode)` replaces the previous subscription. Unsubscribe one slot with `action: "unsubscribe" + interval_ms + mode`, or clear everything with `action: "unsubscribe_all"`.

**Cadence (`interval_ms`):** `500`, `1000`, `3000`, or `10000`. Each cadence is a separate flush bucket — ids/filters subscribed at 500ms see updates up to 2× per second, 10000ms once per 10s.

**Filter mode:** Evaluated on every flush against rows that actually changed since the last tick. Same validation as the REST list endpoint (timeframe, search length, list size caps). `search` is a case-insensitive substring match on `title` (not FTS). No sort / limit — you get every matching row that changed.

**Ids mode:** Filter by explicit `event_slugs` and/or `event_ids`. Max 500 ids per subscription. Updates push when a matching event changes.

**When updates fire:** updates are sent when matching event rows change. Quiet events produce zero messages.

polymarket_markets_stream.title: Markets Stream
polymarket_markets_stream.summary: Real-time Polymarket markets stream — filter or ids mode, 500ms to 10s cadence
polymarket_markets_stream.description:
Low-latency push feed of market rows — same row shape `GET /polymarket/market` returns, including per-outcome price with `latest_block` + `latest_confirmed_at` watermarks. The stream sends updates for open markets as market data, prices, and activity change.

**Seeding:** No initial snapshot is pushed on subscribe. Clients seed from `GET /polymarket/market` and then apply deltas from this stream.

**Subscription model:** A client has up to 8 active slots per room (4 cadences × 2 modes). Re-subscribing to the same `(interval_ms, mode)` replaces the previous subscription. Unsubscribe one slot with `action: "unsubscribe" + interval_ms + mode`, or clear everything with `action: "unsubscribe_all"`.

**Cadence (`interval_ms`):** `500`, `1000`, `3000`, or `10000`.

**Filter mode:** Same validation as the REST list endpoint (timeframe, search length, list caps). `search` is a case-insensitive substring match on `title`. No sort / limit — you get every matching row that changed.

**Ids mode:** Any combination of `condition_ids`, `market_slugs`, and `event_slugs` (matches all child markets of those events). Max 500 total per subscription.

**When updates fire:** updates are sent when matching market rows change. Quiet markets produce zero messages.

**Outcome prices:** Each outcome in `outcomes[]` carries `latest_block` and `latest_confirmed_at` (Unix seconds) — the block/ts of the most recent price update. Consumers can use these to reject out-of-order price merges locally.

When set, the first trade seen for a position opens a window of this duration.
The opening price becomes the baseline, and every subsequent trade within the
window is compared to it. When the window expires the next trade starts a new
window. If omitted, the baseline accumulates indefinitely until a spike fires.

Example: `60` to detect spikes that happen within 60 seconds.

OrderBookUpdateEvent.description: Server-pushed event: full CLOB orderbook snapshot for an outcome token. Envelope type: "order_book_update". Delivered whenever the book changes for a subscribed condition or position.

bids.description: Bid levels sorted best-first (highest price first)

asks.description: Ask levels sorted best-first (lowest price first)

hash.description: Orderbook content hash — identical hash means no change

bid_liquidity_usd.description: Total USD value of all bid levels

ask_liquidity_usd.description: Total USD value of all ask levels

ClobRewardsSubscribeMessage.description: Subscribe to CLOB reward changes. Either provide specific condition_ids or set subscribe_all to true.

condition_ids.description: Condition IDs to watch for reward changes.

subscribe_all.description: If true, receive ALL reward changes across all markets. Overrides condition_ids.

ClobRewardsSubscribeResponse.description: Server acknowledgement for a CLOB rewards subscription. Envelope type: "clob_rewards_stream_subscribe_response".

condition_ids.description: Accepted condition IDs

ClobRewardsUpdateEvent.description: Server-pushed CLOB reward change event. Envelope type: "clob_rewards_update".

rewards_max_spread.description: Max spread to qualify for rewards

rewards_min_size.description: Min order size to qualify for rewards

action.description: `subscribe` creates/replaces a slot. `unsubscribe` removes one slot (needs `mode` + `interval_ms`). `unsubscribe_all` removes every slot this client holds in the room.

interval_ms.description: Flush cadence. Required for subscribe / unsubscribe. Default 1000 if omitted.

filter.description: Filter body (only used when `mode=filter`). All fields optional; omitted fields are unconstrained.

event_slugs.description: Ids mode: event slugs to watch. Combined with `event_ids` up to 500 total.

event_ids.description: Ids mode: event ids to watch. Combined with `event_slugs` up to 500 total.

EventsStreamFilter.description: List-API-shaped filter evaluated in-memory against changed rows. `status` is NOT an accepted field — the cache only holds open events.

tags.description: Match by tag slug OR label (case-insensitive).

timeframe.description: Timeframe that `volume`/`txns`/`unique_traders` thresholds are evaluated against. Default `24h`.

EventsStreamSubscribeResponse.description: Server acknowledgement for an events_stream subscribe/unsubscribe. Envelope type: "events_stream_subscribe_response".

event_slugs.description: Accepted ids (ids mode only). Empty in filter mode.

error.description: Non-null when the subscribe was rejected (invalid cadence, bad filter, too many subs, …).

EventsStreamUpdateEvent.description: Server-pushed event: one or more open events matching this subscription had a field change since the last tick. Envelope type: "events_stream_update". Only rows that changed AND matched are in `data`. Client merges into its local state by `id`.

data.description: Full `PolymarketEvent` rows (same shape as `GET /polymarket/events`). Not a delta — each array element is a complete row replacement.

action.description: `subscribe` creates/replaces a slot. `unsubscribe` removes one slot (needs `mode` + `interval_ms`). `unsubscribe_all` removes every slot this client holds in the room.

interval_ms.description: Flush cadence. Required for subscribe / unsubscribe. Default 1000 if omitted.

filter.description: Filter body (only used when `mode=filter`). All fields optional.

condition_ids.description: Ids mode: 0x-prefixed lowercase 32-byte hex. Counts toward the 500-id cap.

event_slugs.description: Ids mode: event slug strings — matches every child market of each event.
